title: Changes to the Seed Enterprise Investment Scheme, Enterprise Investment Scheme and Venture Capital Trusts
text:
This measure makes changes to the Seed Enterprise Investment Scheme ( SEIS ), Enterprise Investment Scheme ( EIS ) and Venture Capital Trusts ( VCT ) scheme rules.

 The changes will:

 • allow EIS tax relief to remain available on the part of an investment that is within the scheme limits when an investment exceeds those limits

 • allow SEIS and EIS or VCT investments to be made on the same day

 • prevent a late payment by one or more investors from affecting the tax relief available to other investors

 • align the SEIS rules for interest charged when tax relief is withdrawn or reduced with the equivalent EIS rules

 • amend the VCT rules so that any withdrawal of Income Tax relief is calculated using the rate that applied when the shares were issued
